title: Senior GTM Engineering Analyst
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

At 1Password, we believe everyone deserves to be safe online. As a Senior GTM Engineering Analyst, you’ll build artificial intelligence (AI) agents, data products, and analysis workflows that help global go-to-market teams work faster and make better decisions.

You’ll connect information across business systems, automate repetitive processes, and create reliable insights for leaders across Sales, Solutions, Customer Experience, and Channel. Your work will help make security simpler and more human-centric for the millions of people and thousands of businesses that rely on 1Password. This role reports to the Director, GTM Engineering (Revenue Operations)

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate - from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs - creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

• Bring 4+ years of experience in analytics, revenue operations, sales operations, data analysis, or a related field.

• Have experience building AI agents or workflows powered by large language models (LLMs) that have been used in real business work.

• Work confidently with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.

• Use Structured Query Language (SQL) effectively and apply working knowledge of statistics to distinguish meaningful results from noise.

• Document and improve business processes with a focus on reducing manual work and improving decision-making.

Bonus points for:

• Have experience with Python for building automations, working with application programming interfaces (APIs), and connecting systems, along with go-to-market tools such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or business intelligence platforms.

• Have supported channel or partner sales motions, worked across multiple regions, or studied a quantitative discipline such as science, engineering, statistics, or mathematics.

What you can expect:

• Rebuild sales and revenue operations processes to reduce manual work.

• Build and maintain AI agents that prepare call and deal briefs, draft customer follow-ups, rank target accounts, and flag deals that need attention.

title: HPC Network Engineer
description:
We are looking for a motivated HPC (High Performance Computing) Network Engineer to support and grow within our infrastructure team. This role is ideal for engineers with a strong foundation in networking who are interested in developing deep expertise in InfiniBand, HPC/AI infrastructure, and network security using Fortinet technologies.
You will work alongside senior engineers to operate, troubleshoot, and improve high-performance network environments, with a clear growth path toward becoming a Senior HPC Network Engineer.
Key Responsibilities:

• Support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of InfiniBand and Ethernet network infrastructure.

• Assist in troubleshooting network issues, including connectivity, latency, and performance degradation.

• Monitor network health and performance using standard tools and assist in identifying bottlenecks.

• Work with InfiniBand technologies (switches, HCAs, subnet managers) under guidance from senior engineers.

• Support management and troubleshooting of Fortinet solutions (FortiGate, VPNs, firewall rules).

• Assist in implementing network configurations, routing, and segmentation.

• Collaborate with compute and storage teams to support HPC and AI workloads.

• Participate in incident response and operational support activities.

• Contribute to documentation of network configurations and procedures.

• Learn and adopt automation tools and practices (e.g., Ansible, scripting).

Required Qualifications:

• 2-4 years of experience in networking, system engineering, or infrastructure roles.

• Basic understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs).

• Familiarity with Linux systems and command-line tools.

• Exposure to data center networking or distributed systems environments.

• Strong willingness to learn and develop expertise in InfiniBand and HPC networking.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Exposure to InfiniBand or high-performance networking concepts.

• Familiarity with Fortinet or other firewall technologies.

• Basic scripting skills (e.g., Bash or Python).

• Understanding of monitoring tools and troubleshooting methodologies.

Growth Opportunities:

• Hands-on training with InfiniBand fabrics and HPC networking tools.

• Mentorship from senior engineers and involvement in complex troubleshooting scenarios.

• Opportunity to gain experience with RDMA, MPI workloads, and large-scale cluster environments.

• Path toward a Senior HPC Network Engineer role with increasing ownership and responsibility.

What We’re Looking For:

• A strong problem-solver with curiosity about how systems work at a deeper level.

• Someone eager to learn and take on increasingly complex networking challenges.

• A team player who can collaborate effectively and grow within a high-performance engineering environment.

What does Mirantis offer you?

• Work with some of the most advanced AI infrastructure environments in production today.

• Gain exposure to NVIDIA GPU technologies, Kubernetes platforms, and high-performance networking environments.

• Help define how next-generation AI infrastructure is operated and supported.

• Be part of a team shaping the future of AI-powered operations through k0rdent AI.

• Join a growing organisation investing heavily in AI infrastructure and platform services.

• Salary range: $60000-$67000 gross per year

Technical Expertise

Them: Federal and state agencies that are abusing their power and stripping Americans of their rights. There’s no shortage of agencies that ignore the Constitution’s separation of powers. But fortunately, abusive government is most vulnerable when countered by individuals who act strategically and nimbly, take calculated risks, and are confident in, and passionate for, the cause-the very sort of swashbucklers who work at PLF.
Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the United States Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 litigated at the Court-including three victories last term. We also have nearly two hundred active cases across the nation.
We are a next-generation public interest law firm. That means we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.
Here’s what you get to do in this role:
You will generate and lead high-profile cases in PLF’s Separation of Powers practice group. Your ideas will help shape PLF strategy by identifying and litigating emerging separation of powers theories. You will give speeches, appear in media, and publish op-eds and scholarly articles on cutting edge issues in administrative and constitutional law.
You will work on teams with other top-notch attorneys, applying your skills, knowledge, and passion every day. You will have the latitude to think big and the resources to execute. You will be at the leading edge of Constitutional law in America.
In a nutshell, we’re seeking experienced attorneys to help us continue our legacy of success. You must be passionate about liberty, the Constitution, and fighting the administrative state, confident and magnanimous, and a bold and relentless freedom fighter.

•
Generating and litigating high-impact cases: As an experienced litigator, you will take ownership of established cases while also developing and driving your own. We want confident self-starters who think big and aim high.

•
Setting the Agenda: Every attorney on the team helps develop successful strategies so we can keep the victories coming.

•
Advocating for separation of powers: We win in the courts of law and in the court of public opinion. You will speak with organizations, trade groups, academics, students and the public to advance our strategic goals. (A deep knowledge of the moral and constitutional basis for the Constitution’s structural protections is a huge plus.)

•
Writing persuasively for all audiences: You will write briefs, op-eds, journal articles, blog posts, and more.

This role is ideal for someone with:

• 7+ years of experience

• Outstanding interpersonal and communications skills

• A knowledge of, and passion for, the ideas of freedom and individual liberty

• A strong work ethic

• A willingness to travel

• Litigation experience

• A clerkship or work with a state or federal agency

General Information:

Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that will benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, we battle for freedom in the nation’s courts and the court of public opinion.

description:

さらに、この役割はソフォスの脅威対策ユニット（CTU）との主要な連絡窓口として、調査結果に攻撃者の戦術、技術、インフラに関する最新のインテリジェンスを反映させます。また、運用上の知見を、お客様や社内チーム向けの実行可能なガイダンスに変換する役割も担います。

As a global platform revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers, and potential to turn into performance. With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm-220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.
Your Role in Our Mission
As Head of Risk at FundedNext, you will own the most strategically important function in any prop trading firm: the discipline that protects platform integrity and stabilises the economics that fund every trader’s journey. You will report directly to the FundedNext CEO and become the senior owner of risk decisions across CFD and Futures - and the lead architect of risk infrastructure for the upcoming Crypto programme.

How You’ll Make an Impact
Stabilise the Book

• Reduce payout ratio variance and bring discipline to the firm’s primary health metric across CFD and Futures. Translate trader behaviour data into product-rule decisions that protect long-term sustainability without throttling the trader experience.

Audit, Then Build

• In your first 90 days, conduct an end-to-end gap analysis of our existing risk framework - surveillance tooling, policies, escalation paths, dealing operations integration. From that diagnostic, design and implement a risk operating model fit for FundedNext’s scale through 2028.

Lead Crypto Risk Readiness

Hunt Fraud and Abuse

• Strengthen detection and response to multi-account abuse, identity fraud, and toxic trading patterns. Partner with Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Customer Operations to build a defensible, scalable abuse-prevention capability.

Partner Across the Firm

• Be the trusted risk voice in product design, dealing operations, engineering, compliance, and analytics. Influence - and where required, veto - decisions that materially shift FundedNext’s risk profile. You will report directly to the CEO and have the authority to escalate independently when material risk events demand it.

What You Bring

• 8-12 years of risk experience across prop trading, CFD brokerage, or multi-asset financial services.

• Genuine multi-asset fluency - you understand CFD, Futures, and ideally Crypto economics, instruments, and abuse patterns.

• A track record of building or rebuilding a risk function - frameworks, policies, surveillance tooling, team.

• Hands-on credibility on B-book and dealing operations; you have personal exposure to payout ratio management at scale.

• Strong cross-functional influence - you can hold your own with Product, Engineering, and Trading leaders.

• Comfort with ambiguity - you can step into an under-defined function and bring clarity quickly.

• Excellent communication - to traders, to your CEO, to your future board.

Your X-Factor

• You have personal scar tissue from a payout-ratio crisis or major abuse incident - and you can talk about how you turned it around.

• You speak the language of data and engineering well enough to design surveillance models with quants and ML engineers, even if you don’t write production code yourself.

• You have led risk policy design for a new asset class launch - ideally Crypto.

• You think about trader experience and risk economics in the same sentence - not as opposing forces.

title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
description:
About the Role
We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment.
What You’ll Do

• Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement

• Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design)

• Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models

• Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance

• Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions

• Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate

• Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models

What We’re Looking For

• Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling

• Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.)

• Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages

•
Solid understanding of:

• Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models

• Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias

• Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning

• Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.)

• Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment

Nice to Have

• Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts

• Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling

• Experience training or evaluating large language models

• Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA)

Why Join Us

• Real ownership over research direction and impact

• A team that values papers and production

• Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration

• Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic is growing quickly across Asia Pacific, and our International Recruiting Coordination team is building for it. As our first Recruiting Coordinator based in [Singapore], you'll deliver a warm, high touch interview experience for candidates across APAC, including Japan, Korea, India, Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia. You'll partner closely with our APAC recruiters and recruiting managers, be the local point of contact for candidates and interviewers in the region and help keep hiring moving around the clock as part of a follow the sun coordination model with your teammates.

As you'll be first in seat, you'll also help shape how coordination works in a region where we're still building: spotting what's missing, documenting what works and making it easier for the people who join after you.

You'll own coordination for your region end to end and act as our go to operator for APAC hiring logistics, working independently with support from your manager.

• Improve our processes and document what works.

• Independently scope and lead projects, from problem to adopted solution.

You may be a good fit if you have:

• 4+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or high volume scheduling, ideally supporting multiple APAC markets.

• Comfort creating structure where there isn't one yet, and the judgment to know when to escalate.

• Hands on fluency with AI tools, and the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to override it.

• A love of feedback, and comfort both requesting and providing it.

• Fluency in English (native or business-level).

• Additional APAC languages (e.g., Japanese, Korean or Mandarin) a plus.

• A genuine interest in Anthropic's mission and our deep commitment to AI safety.

title: Strategic Finance Lead
description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to embed with the teams that drive our business - GTM, Product, and others as we grow - and raise the quality of decisions across the company. This is a partnering seat, not a reporting one: you’ll be in the room when a decision is being framed, not summarizing it afterward.
You’ll own the financial models for the areas you support, end to end. Because you own them, you’re in the decision rather than downstream of it. When a metric moves, your job isn’t to report that it moved - it’s to explain why, say whether that’s good or bad, and recommend what to do about it. When your business partners are weighing a decision, you’re the person quantifying the return.
You won’t inherit a playbook. You’ll write one - defining how finance partners with the business as the function grows.
The bar we’re setting
Today, a conversation about CAC often ends at “CAC went to $X because spend changed.” That’s arithmetic. We want a partner who asks the next questions: why did spend move - was it a deliberate test? What was the hypothesis, and how did it perform? How do we know our experiments are working? Is this a healthy shift or an early warning?
That’s the difference between reporting numbers and driving decisions, and it’s the heart of this role. We have good visibility into top-line trends; what we want is the ability to go a level deeper, consistently. That takes persistence - following the signal and going to find the data rather than waiting for it.
What you’ll cover
Today this role partners most closely with GTM - subscriber forecasting - and Product, where you’ll forecast TPV and revenue by product line and payment rail. As we grow, that will likely extend to Payments Strategy, Risk, and Operations.
We’ll be straight with you: we haven’t fully defined what finance support for those teams looks like yet, and we don’t expect one person to cover everything at once. Part of this job is helping us decide where finance partnership earns the most - and saying so when something should wait.
Your models serve two audiences: the teams they’re built for, and the company plan they roll into. We want models shaped to how each part of the business actually works that still connect cleanly to the central budget - so we plan from one picture instead of reconciling siloed models before a board meeting.
Build the system, not just the model
We’re not planning to solve capacity by adding people. We’d rather solve it with infrastructure: SQL pulling live from Databricks into models that refresh themselves, analysis that’s reproducible instead of rebuilt each month, and AI in the workflow where it genuinely saves time. You should be the kind of person who, faced with a manual process, gets slightly irritated and fixes it.
Much of our forecasting runs on Excel today, supported by live pipelines from our data warehouse. We know we’ll need something more scalable - and we’re deliberately open about what that is, whether a dedicated FP&A tool, a rebuild that leans harder on automation, or a different architecture altogether. You’ll help us decide and build it.
The team, and where this goes
Strategic finance is three people: the Senior Director (your manager), a Senior Financial Analyst, and you. The analyst owns the core FP&A engine - the company model, actuals, month-end performance analysis, and investor reporting. You’ll own the function-level models that feed it. You’re peers with distinct focus areas, and the expectatio

title: Staff AI Security Architect
description:
Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange. Our vision is that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

Our platform is powered by the largest, most diverse health data network in the U.S., enabling data to be secure, accessible and usable to inform better health decisions. Datavant is trusted by the world’s leading life sciences companies, government agencies, and those who deliver and pay for care.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a high-performing, values-driven team. Together, we’re rising to the challenge of tackling some of healthcare’s most complex problems with technology-forward solutions. Datavant ers bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.

What We’re Looking For
As a Staff AI Security Architect at Datavant , you will lead the design, evolution, and adoption of secure by design principles across our AI and Machine Learning (ML) systems. This role sits at the intersection of AI innovation and security architecture. You will define and operationalize AI security strategy, embed security into the AI/ML development lifecycle, and partner deeply with data science, engineering, product, legal, and compliance teams to ensure our AI systems are secure, trustworthy, and scalable.
What You Will Do

• Establish AI security architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices adopted across engineering teams.

• Architect and advise on secure end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and agentic workflows.

• Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and risk assessments for AI-driven products, including LLMs, agent frameworks, and multi-agent systems.

• Define and evolve a comprehensive AI/ML secure development lifecycle integrated into existing SDLC practices.

• Develop reference architectures, documentation, and reusable security components to accelerate secure AI adoption.

• Collaborate with legal, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI stakeholders to align security controls with regulatory and ethical requirements.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on AI security risks, trade-offs, and long-term strategy.

What You Need to Succeed

• 8+ years of experience in security architecture, application security, or product security, with meaningful focus on AI/ML systems.

• Hands-on experience securing AI/ML or LLM-based systems, including familiarity with modern AI architectures and agentic workflows.

• Strong understanding of AI threat models, including adversarial ML, prompt injection, data poisoning, model theft, and abuse scenarios.

• Proven ability to design and influence security architectures for large-scale, distributed systems.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Have a strong understanding of security controls, both those that exist in audit standards as well as practical controls that can help reduce risk and increase safety.

What Helps You Stand Out

• Hands-on experience building, testing, or tinkering with agentic AI workflows, with an understanding of the security risks they introduce.

• Experience securing AI/ML workloads in Databricks, with a deep understanding of its platform-specific security risks.

• You have experience with security in healthcare or other highly regulated space. Examples: HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI, FedRamp experience from an operational response standpoint.

We are committed to building a diverse team of Datavant ers who are all responsible for stewarding a high-performance culture in which all Datavant ers belong and thrive. title: Chief of Staff to the CEO (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs - von der Suche und Finanzierung bis zum Kauf und zur Verwaltung. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Software, besseren Prozessen und starken Teams weiter.

Unterstützt von GV arbeiten wir daran, mehr Menschen den Zugang zu Wohneigentum und damit zum Vermögensaufbau zu ermöglichen.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten Herausforderungen von Buena.

Dein Aufgabenbereich wächst mit Buena. Du solltest Freude daran haben, dich schnell in unbekannte Themen einzuarbeiten, dir eine eigene Meinung zu bilden und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, bevor dir jemand einen detaillierten Auftrag gibt.

DEINE VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Projekte, die Buena voranbringen. Du übernimmst wichtige Aufgaben in Operations und Product. Du definierst das Ziel, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und steuerst die Umsetzung.

- Fundierte Entscheidungen. Du prüfst neue Möglichkeiten, analysierst Zahlen und sprichst mit den Menschen, die das Problem aus erster Hand kennen. Daraus entwickelst du klare Empfehlungen für den CEO.

- Konsequente Umsetzung. Du übersetzt Entscheidungen in klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Termine und nächste Schritte. Hindernisse erkennst du früh und räumst sie gemeinsam mit den Teams aus dem Weg.

- Klare Kommunikation. Du bereitest Unternehmensupdates, Gespräche im Führungsteam und Investorenunterlagen mit vor. Komplexe Themen bringst du verständlich auf den Punkt

DU PASST ZU DIESER BESONDEREN ROLLE, WENN DU

- Schon früh außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt hast. Du hast bereits Verantwortung übernommen, die deutlich über das für deine Erfahrung übliche Maß hinausgeht. Deinen persönlichen Beitrag kannst du an konkreten Ergebnissen zeigen.

- Extreme Eigeninitiative mitbringst. Du wartest weder auf einen Auftrag noch auf eine Anleitung. Wenn du ein Problem erkennst, findest du heraus, was nötig ist, und bringst die Lösung selbst ins Rollen.

- Dich durchbeißt. Eine ausbleibende Antwort, ein erstes Nein oder ein „Das geht bei uns nicht“ ist für dich kein Endpunkt. Du fasst nach, verstehst die Einwände, findest andere Zugänge und gewinnst die richtigen Menschen für die Lösung.

- Verantwortung am Ergebnis misst. Eine verschickte E-Mail ist für dich noch keine erledigte Aufgabe. Du bleibst dran, bis das Problem gelöst ist, und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Zusagen Ergebnisse werden.

- Extrem schnell lernst und analytisch stark bist. Du durchdringst unbekannte Themen, hinterfragst Annahmen und leitest aus komplexen Informationen klare Entscheidungen ab. Fehlendes Vorwissen arbeitest du dir eigenständig an.

- Hohe Geschwindigkeit mit hoher Qualität verbindest. Du setzt klare Prioritäten, hältst Zusagen ein und lieferst auch unter Zeitdruck durchdachte Ergebnisse. Bei Hindernissen kommst du mit konkreten Lösungsvorschlägen.

- Hohe Ansprüche an dich selbst stellst. Du suchst ehrliches Feedback, sprichst eigene Fehler offen an und setzt das Gelernte schnell um.

- Andere durch Klarheit und Urteilsvermögen überzeugst. Du kannst mit Geschäftsführern auf Augenhöhe arbeiten, schwierige Themen direkt ansprechen und dem CEO fundiert widersprechen.

- Fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst und gemeinsam mit uns vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten möchtest.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

- MacBook & Studio Display.

- Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

- Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

- Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Du baust, statt zu verwalten: Ein HR-Playbook für 1.000 Mitarbeiter gibt es bei uns noch nicht.

- Wir wachsen schnell mit einem kleinen Team: In den letzten drei Jahren zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit ~25 Voll

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER

Location: Hybrid remote/Aldgate, London - onsite 1-3 days per week

Salary: £55,000-£70,000
SC Clearance Requirements:

Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for this position. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance.

You must be UK based.

AT A GLANCE

You won't just fill your own vertical. You'll own it: the pipeline, the hiring leader relationship, and at least one initiative that outlasts any single requisition.

THE MOMENT

Cloudscaler is 130 people today, heading to 170 by the end of this year and roughly double again across 2027. Talent Acquisition is being rebuilt around a new Talent Acquisition Manager, with a team of three to five Partners forming from close to a standing start.

You'll be one of the first people in that team, which means the vertical you're given is genuinely yours to shape. Nobody has already worked out what good looks like for it.

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT

A lot of Talent Acquisition Partner roles are really a narrow desk: work the reqs you're given, hand off at offer, move to the next one. Here is where this role goes further.

- Instead of a desk you're assigned, a technical vertical you own end to end

- Instead of requisitions handed to you, direct-sourcing pipelines you build yourself

- Instead of recruitment only, recruitment plus a real TA initiative, including early careers

- Instead of being handed off at offer, a clean handover into onboarding, and a relationship with the hiring leader that continues

THE ROLE

You'll sit in the Talent Acquisition team reporting to the Talent Acquisition Manager, alongside two to four other Partners. You'll run full-lifecycle recruitment for a technical vertical you own (sourcing, screening, interview process and offer), while business partnering directly with the hiring leaders in it.

Alongside your own pipeline, you'll own a Talent Acquisition initiative that matters beyond any single hire, most likely our early careers programme: graduates, apprentices and the pipeline that feeds them.

WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS

New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today.

Yours

- Full-lifecycle recruitment for your vertical: sourcing, screening, interview coordination and offer

- Direct-sourcing pipelines for recurring or hard-to-fill roles in your vertical

- Business partnering with the hiring leaders in your vertical

- Ownership of at least one TA initiative, such as early careers

Shared

- The handover from offer to start date, which the People Partner team picks up

- Capacity across the team during peak periods (you'll help outside your vertical when it's needed)

- Agency relationships and overall sourcing strategy, which the Talent Acquisition Manager owns

Not yours

- Employee relations casework and onboarding delivery, which sit with the People Partner team

- Ashby architecture, agency management and team capacity planning, which sit with the Talent Acquisition Manager

THE STACK

- Ashby: Our applicant tracking system. You'll keep your own pipeline data clean and current, as it feeds directly into team reporting.

- Metaview: Interview intelligence, which you'll use to sharpen your own interviewing and get feedback on it.

- Rippling: The employee records. You'll work in it around offer and handover, alongside the People Partner team.

- Claude: A daily tool here. You'll use it for role briefs, market mapping, candidate communication and case notes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own your vertical. You'll run full-lifecycle recruitment for a technical vertical, becoming the person hiring leaders in it trust first.

Build direct-sourcing pipelines. You'll proactively map and engage candidates for your recurring or hardest-to-fill roles, rather than waiting on inbound applications.

En Flix encontraras equipos que se unen para superar desafíos y fomentar la creatividad. Creemos en una cultura de responsabilidad, dandote la libertad de tomar iniciativa, generar impacto y construir tu propio camino profesional. A medida que continuamos expandiendonos en todo el mundo, puedes marcar una verdadera diferencia en la forma que trabajamos.

Si estás listo para crecer y liderar tu propio camino, ¡Flix es el lugar para ti!

title: Director of Category and Shopper Insights
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY:
Hint Inc. is a leading flavored water company dedicated to delivering high-quality products to consumers throughout the US. We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly analytical leader to elevate our category insight capabilities. This role is critical in shaping our Market position, driving actionable insights, and enabling both Sales and Brand teams to make informed decisions that accelerate growth.
The Director of Category and Shopper Insights will serve as the go-to category expert for both internal teams and external retail partners, translating complex data into compelling narratives, recommendations, and strategies. This role is a key member of the Customer Development team while working closely with National Accounts, Brand Marketing, and revenue Growth Management to inform execution, guide priorities and identify growth opportunities across current and adjacent categories.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the category narrative: Transform data into compelling, actionable stores for Sales, Brand, and leadership teams.

• Deliver insight-led recommendations: Provide credible, forward-looking insights that shape joint business planning, assortment strategies, pricing, and promotion guidance and revenue growth initiatives.

• Enable Sales Excellence: Equip Sales teams with turnkey selling narratives, and dashboards to quickly act on insights and strengthen customer conversations.

• Support Brand Strategy: Provide Category and shopper context to refine identify whitespace opportunities.

• Synthesize data across sources: Consolidate syndicated data, internal sales data, shopper trends, panel metrics and market intelligence into single, actionable category point of view.

• Drive Cross functional alignment: Partner closely with customer development, Sales, revenue growth management, finance, and brand marketing to ensure consistent execution and strategy alignment.

• Advance category expertise: Serve as the internal expert, guiding decisions, and strategy as the business defends space and expands into adjacent categories.

• Develop tools and frameworks: Improve and create reporting and analytical tools that allow teams to extrapolate insights efficiently, enhancing execution at national, regional, and channel levels.

• Communication to influence: Prense complex analyses and recommendations clearly to leadership and retail partners.
Requirements
Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field (MBA preferred).

• 7+ years of experience in Category Management, Category Insights, or Shopper Insights within the CPG or beverage industry.

• Strong understanding of category management, shopper behavior, and retail market analysis.

• Experience using syndicated data tools such as SPINS, IRI/Circana, Numerator, and Kroger Stratum/84.51°.

• Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IF statements, SUMIFS).

• Strong PowerPoint and data storytelling skills to turn data into clear insights and recommendations.

• Experience supporting sales teams, customer development, and joint business planning with retail partners.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Python (x/f/m)
description:
We are looking for a Python Senior Software Engineer to join the ATP team in Application Platform Domain.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your mission will be to work on designing and delivering essential components that empower Doctolib teams to build robust and scalable services. You will be working in a feature team developing the chassis, archetypes, business-agnostic services, cross-cutting concerns and Claude Plugins.

You will be working in a platform feature team developing the Python and Java/Kotlin chassis, project archetypes, business-agnostic services, cross-cutting concerns (resilience, security, observability…) and Claude Plugins, used by more than 60 services across Doctolib.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and implement features to improve the Doctolib platform

- Take a leading role within the team and contribute to establishing a technical vision that ensures the performance, security, and usability of the platform, taking into account the future needs and the high scalability needs

- Bring your expertise and experiences to help us continuously improve the way we implement, test, and monitor high-quality features

- Improving the performance of key features implemented in Python, sometimes completely challenging the status quo

- Taking leadership on delivering roadmap items (together with the team)

- Contributing to establishing a technical vision and co-drive the creation of the roadmap for next quarters

ABOUT OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

- Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components. 

- Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

- We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/!

WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

- You are proactive, curious, collaborative and eager to learn

- You are primarily a backend engineer with expert knowledge of Python 

- You have a solid understanding of web technologies and software development life cycle

- You have a “user first” mindset and want to build a product focused on bringing value to its users, through secure, well-tested and pragmatic code

- You are fluent in English

Now it would be fantastic if you

- have experience with Kafka and Kubernetes

- have experience with ADK and ML libraries

- have experience with Java or Kotlin

WHAT WE OFFER

- Free comprehensive health insurance for you and your children

- Parent Care Program: additional leave on top of the legal parental leave

- Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

- For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

- Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

- Up to 14 days of RTT

- A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class 

- Lunch voucher with Swile card

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview 

- Feature Building Interview 

- System Design Interview

- Behavioral Interview

- At least one reference check

title: Affiliate & Creator Marketing Lead
description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on. Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

The Affiliate & Creator Marketing Lead joins Runpod's Marketing team, a lean, high-output team responsible for how Runpod shows up across every channel developers and infrastructure buyers touch. This role reports to the Director of Growth & Demand Gen and works closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, PR/Comms, DevRel, and Sales. Affiliate is already one of Runpod's most productive acquisition channels. It has historically been supported by agency partners (Advertise Purple, FNF), both of which are winding down as this hire brings affiliate and creator management fully in-house; PartnerStack remains our platform of record. A separate influencer motion has run out of PR/Comms as one-off creator activations (sponsored newsletters, YouTube drops) measured on impressions and clicks; that motion is now being folded under Demand Gen, with the mandate to shift it from an awareness metric to a signups-and-revenue one.

We're looking for a hands-on Affiliate & Creator Marketing Lead to own and scale Runpod's affiliate program while completing the consolidation of our influencer and creator relationships into that same motion. This is a mid-senior role for someone who thrives on relationship-building, incentive design, and finding the next great creator to partner with before anyone else does. You'll grow the affiliate program's reach, deepen relationships with existing affiliates, scout and sign new creators across the internet, fold the right ones into the affiliate program with properly structured incentives, and turn one-off sponsored placements into an ongoing, performance-based partnership. You'll also partner with DevRel on community and creator discovery, and support Product Marketing in extending the reach of the executive team's personal accounts.

You're inheriting two programs with real traction, not a blank page: the affiliate program already drives meaningful signups and revenue every week, and the influencer program has already landed real creators and real impressions. What's missing is the connective tissue: a single motion where creators are incentivized on signups and revenue instead of one-off sponsorship fees, where the best affiliates and the best creators are treated as the same kind of partner, and where finding the next great partner is a repeatable process instead of an ad hoc one. Get this right and it becomes one of Runpod's most efficient and most visible growth channels.

Responsibilities:

Affiliate Program Growth

- Own and scale Runpod's affiliate program end to end, taking over agency-managed relationships (Advertise Purple, FNF) as those contracts wind down and bringing affiliate management fully in-house.

- Strengthen relationships with existing high-performing affiliates through proactive outreach, better communication, and improved support.

- Monitor affiliate performance and program health (signups, fraud signals, engagement) in PartnerStack, our platform of record, and partner with Marketing Ops to keep tracking and attribution accurate.

- Continuously test and refine commission structures, tiering, and incentives (challenges, competitions, utilization-based kickbacks) to maximize both signups and progra

Position Overview
Boyd Thermal is seeking a Vice President of Sales to lead the global commercial organization for its Coolant Distribution Unit business, a portfolio scaling past $1B in revenue next year. This executive owns the global revenue number: the sales strategy, the customer and channel architecture, the pricing discipline that protects gross margin, and the forecasting rigor a business of this growth rate demands. The successful candidate will be a thought leader who provides key observations and ideas, identifies risks and opportunities early, and is comfortable operating hands-on with customers, engineering teams, and manufacturing sites across multiple regions. Scaling a business from hundreds of millions to more than $1B is fundamentally a question of capacity, commitment, and disciplined commercial execution - this leader will be measured on all three, and on building the sales organization, processes, and customer relationships that make the next $1B repeatable rather than opportunistic.

Revenue Ownership and Commercial Strategy

title: Account Partner - SMB - Nordics
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As an Account Partner for Veeva's Quality Cloud, you will drive growth across the Life Sciences small and medium sized biotechs markets. As part of a foundational team, you will be responsible for generating opportunities, winning new business, and building strategic customer relationships while helping organizations modernize operations through innovative cloud technology.
A strong understanding of the life science industry, the enterprise software sales cycle, and a passion for making market changes with innovative technology are ideal.
What You'll Do

• Manage relationships with key stakeholders across Business, IT, and C-level

• Meet/exceed pipeline generation and revenue targets

• Manage complex sales cycles, utilizing internal and external resources as appropriate

• Keep current with industry trends and engage customers in addressing their business challenges

• Act with urgency, integrity, and a focus on the customer

Requirements

• 5+ years of combined experience in sales and/or consulting, with min. 2 years in the life sciences space.

• Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas

• Consultative Sales experience with Life Science Software Solutions

• Strategic account planning and execution skills

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills

• Ability to work with a wide range of customers from end users to C-level

• Must be highly self-motivated and able to work with little direct supervision

• A passion for solving customer business problems

• Language: English

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

• Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards.

For this role, the portfolio is the company's ambulatory EHR and practice management platform, spanning the clinical documentation, ordering, e-prescribing, scheduling, patient access, and revenue cycle workflows that physician practices and ambulatory organizations depend on daily; the Senior Product Manager therefore pairs strong product craft with domain fluency in ambulatory care delivery and healthcare interoperability.

• Own the product roadmap and backlog for one or more [Clinical Content product areas, from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.

People decide what to trust. What to believe. What to adopt. What to join. What to ignore. The gap between what organizations intend and what people do is where growth is won or lost.
That's where strategy matters. We're looking for a Creative & Brand Strategist to help organizations navigate that gap. This is a senior leadership role for a strategist who can transform complexity into clarity, insight into direction, and direction into ideas that create measurable impact.
You'll work across brand, marketing, customer experience, communications, digital transformation, and organizational challenges - helping clients identify opportunities, define strategic choices, and create meaningful connections with the people they serve.
The Opportunity
As a Creative & Brand Strategist, you will lead strategic development across integrated engagements that span brand, campaign, digital experience, customer engagement, and organizational transformation.
You will partner with researchers, behavioral scientists, consultants, creatives, technologists, and client leaders to uncover what drives decisions and define what should happen next.
You'll be responsible for shaping the strategic foundation behind the work: identifying opportunities, framing challenges, developing positioning, creating narratives, and inspiring ideas that move people to action.

• Develop brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks, narrative platforms, and campaign strategies.

• Partner with research, analytics and account teams to unlock audience drivers, develop personas and segmentation strategies that drive program development and delivery.

• Contribute to developing key performance indicators and program evaluation approaches.

• Create clear, inspiring briefs that drive exceptional creative and experience design work.

• Facilitate stakeholder workshops, executive alignment sessions, and strategic planning engagements.

• Identify emerging cultural, behavioral, and market shifts that create new opportunities for clients.

• Partner closely with research, customer experience, creative, digital, consulting, and account teams to solve complex business challenges.

• Check for strategy and brand consistency in creative concepting and delivery.

What We're Looking For
You are a strategist first. You know how to uncover meaningful insights, define compelling positions, build persuasive narratives, and create strategic direction that inspires action. You understand that brands are not simply communications systems - they are systems of meaning.
You see audiences as people, not segments. You know how to connect human motivations with organizational goals. You can move comfortably between long-term brand building and immediate business priorities. Between analytical rigor and creative imagination. Between evidence, intuition, and judgment. Most importantly, you know that strategy is not about having all the answers. It's about asking the questions that reveal opportunities others miss.
You Bring:

Professional Skills

• Significant experience in brand strategy, communications planning, creative strategy, customer strategy, consumer behavioral psychology, consulting, or a related discipline.

• A strong track record of leading strategic work across complex, multidisciplinary engagements and with cross-functional marketing teams.

title: Salesforce Administrator II
description:
The Opportunity
As a Salesforce Administrator II, you operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, automation, and customer delivery. You are not a traditional “click-only” administrator: you are a technical problem solver who understands system logic, designs enterprise-grade automations, and can bridge the gap between declarative configuration and custom code.
You will partner closely with Solution Engineers, Architects, and Developers to design, build, and maintain scalable solutions across Sitetracker and core Salesforce platforms, thriving in a hybrid Kanban environment that balances feature work with high-velocity support.
 
What You’ll Do
In this role, you will engage directly with international stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into technical design specifications, designing and maintaining fault-tolerant Salesforce Flows and scalable security architectures. Going beyond standard administration, you will actively configure and tune Salesforce AI systems, perform complex data transformations, and leverage your foundational Apex literacy to independently troubleshoot issues using system debug logs. Ultimately, you will apply a strong understanding of architectural boundaries to determine when solutions require modular, declarative automation versus custom code, ensuring robust, prompt-driven, and highly secure workflows across the enterprise.
 
The Skills You’ll Have
Technical Aptitude, Security & AI
Expertise in Flow Builder, AI system configuration, Data Security, and declarative troubleshooting. Verifiable experience configuring AI systems and understanding sharing architecture, OWDs, and complex permission sets. 
Proactive Communication
Excellent oral and written skills to drive ticket momentum and explain technical limits to non-technical teams. Proven ability to provide unprompted ETA updates and set clear expectations, preventing stakeholder escalations. 
Work Management
High ability to context-switch and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Strong ability to balance ongoing feature projects with urgent, high-priority Kanban support tickets while consistently delivering quality work on time. 
Ecosystem Knowledge & Certifications
Foundational Salesforce platform knowledge and ongoing learning. Practical experience heavily outweighs certifications, but Salesforce Admin or Platform App Builder is preferred.

title: Washington Therapist - Suicide Prevention & Family Support
description:
CareMind, part of the Mindoula Health family is hiring licensed therapists (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) to join our fully remote Suicide Prevention & Family Support Program in Washington .

Compensatio n: For candidates located in Washington State the pay is $90,000 a year. For candidates located outside of Washington, the salary is $75,000 per year plus excellent benefits and the opportunity to work with a fantastic team.

Comprehensive Benefits Package includes:

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Supplemental Life Insurance

• Short Term and Long Term Insurance paid by Mindoula

• 401k, with a company match

• 3 weeks paid vacation each year, 4 mental wellness days and 11 holidays

• Parental Leave: 8 weeks of paid parental leave

• Personal Development Program: $500 credit reimbursement per calendar year

As a Therapist, Suicide Prevention & Family Support (SPFS), you will work in collaborative settings to provide biopsychosocial assessments, individual and group therapy, and work with your team to coordinate care across a range of treatment settings. You will have the ability to manage a caseload and make decisions with appropriate autonomy.

Core Duties:

• Deliver Family-Centered Psychotherapy: Provide evidence-based individual, joint family, and parent/guardian teletherapy for youth (ages 12-26) at high or critical risk of suicide, utilizing family-systems frameworks, C-CBT, DBT skills, and Motivational Interviewing.

• Conduct Suicide Risk Assessment & Safety Planning: Administer validated risk assessment tools (e.g., C-SSRS) and lead real-time Safety Planning, lethal means counseling, and crisis stabilization tailored to both the youth and their family unit.

• Manage Monthly Acuity & Risk Stratification: Complete validated clinical assessments at monthly review periods to measure acuity, track suicide risk trajectory, and dynamically adjust care frequency and treatment goals based on member readiness and family capacity.

• Lead Clinical Care Team Collaboration: Direct the clinical safety strategy in close partnership with assigned Behavioral Health Support Specialists (BHSS) and the 24/7 crisis response team, ensuring aligned roles without duplicating billable services.

• Provide Crisis Escalation Response: Serve as the licensed clinician for high-acuity escalations, executing immediate risk mitigation, triage, and rapid safety plan updates during critical member events.

• Maintain Fee-for-Service & Medicaid Compliance: Complete high-integrity, timely clinical documentation (DAP) that explicitly substantiates medical necessity, suicide risk levels, family interventions, and whole-person care for Medicaid Fee-for-Service (FFS) billing.

• Drive Multimodal Youth & Family Engagement: Utilize multi-platform engagement technology (video, secure messaging, interactive safety apps) to maintain persistent outreach and re-engage ambivalent youth or overwhelmed caregivers.

• Integrate Care Infrastructure & Panel Tracking: Actively participate in interdisciplinary huddles, maintain registry accuracy, and monitor personal KPIs (billable hours, documentation turnaround, and show rates) to optimize clinical outcomes across the program panel.

• Collaborate with the member, family, and healthcare providers to develop an individualized plan of care.

• Develop and coordinate community resources with emphasis on medical, behavioral, suicide prevention, and social services.

• Identify and initiate referrals for social service programs - including financial, psycho-social, community, and state supportive services.

• Document all member assessments, care plans, and referrals provided. Prepare and maintain all required records, reports, paperwork, and member’s diagnostic records, maintaining confidentiality of members at all times.

Skills Required:

• Relentless about prioritizing and following through on assigned tasks independently. Superior time management and organization to complete daily tasks by the end of each day.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Operations
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby with world class technology and product experiences.

As part of Fanatics Collectibles’ continued global growth, we are establishing a new technology hub in Mexico City focused on operational excellence, platform scalability, trust, and customer experience. This team partners closely with Customer Experience (CX), Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, Payments, and Financial Operations organizations to build scalable systems and operational tooling that support millions of users and transactions globally.

Role Summary

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable operational systems that support Customer Experience, Trust & Safety, Fraud Prevention, and Financial Operations across Fanatics Collectibles’ global platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Partner with frontend engineers to define and expose clean, performant APIs and data contracts.

• Work with DevOps/SRE to design robust CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, and alerting.

• Lead the design and implementation of microservices, event-driven workflows, and data pipelines.

• Ensure high availability, scalability, and security for core backend systems.

• Establish best practices for code quality, testing, performance tuning, and documentation.

• Conduct architecture reviews, mentor peers, and promote continuous improvement.

• Spearhead major initiatives-from feature conception through production rollout-across payments, inventory, search, and real-time notification services.

• Identify technical risks, propose solutions, and coordinate cross-team deliveries.

• Stay current on emerging backend technologies, cloud services, and industry trends.

• Lead brown-bag sessions, hackathons, or tech talks to share knowledge across teams.

Basic Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required.

• 8+ years building backend services in high-traffic, distributed environments.

• Deep knowledge of at least one major backend language (e.g., Java, Go, Python, Node.js) and its ecosystem.

• Solid understanding of microservices, REST/GraphQL, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and relational/NoSQL databases.

• Experience in AWS/GCP.

• Hands-on with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

• Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI) and monitoring/logging stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).

title: Sales Representative – Commercial Printing
description:
This is a remote position.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Sales Representative to join a leading commercial printing organization. We are looking for a sales professional with a strong background in the commercial printing industry and an established, portable book of business. This individual will be responsible for driving new business opportunities, managing key client relationships, and expanding market presence by offering comprehensive print, direct mail, fulfillment, packaging, and marketing solutions.
Key Responsibilities

• Leverage an existing portable book of business to generate immediate revenue growth.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with commercial clients across multiple industries.

• Prepare proposals, pricing, and presentations while negotiating contracts and closing profitable business.

• Knowledge of variable data printing (VDP), mailing services, fulfillment operations, packaging, and large-format graphics.

• Existing relationships with marketing agencies, manufacturers, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, financial services, nonprofit organizations, or government agencies.

Requirements

• Proven success selling commercial print, direct mail, large-format printing, fulfillment, packaging, or related print solutions.

• Strong understanding of offset printing, digital printing, direct mail, finishing, fulfillment, and print production processes.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• Experience managing multiple client accounts and sales opportunities simultaneously.

title: Clinical Risk Specialist
description:
Our mission at Talkspace is to help people heal. To get there, we need exceptionally passionate, bright, and motivated people. Want to help over one million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!
We are looking for an experienced Clinical Risk Specialist to join our Clinical Quality, Risk Management team. This role would be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating clinical risk. We are looking for someone who has experience providing Clinical Risk Management and wants to bring their talents to a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace , you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
*This is a remote position with a typical schedule of Monday-Friday daytime hours; Eastern Timezone preferred, but some flexibility if able to attend meetings. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC but we do not require New York residence for this role.*
What You’ll Do

• Risk Monitoring & Response

• Review and document adverse incidents, crisis alerts, higher level of care needs.

• Apply clinical expertise to assess risk-related concerns.

• Provide guidance and/or consultation to providers following a risk-related incident.

• Facilitate debriefing and Psychological First Aid (PFA) following significant sentinel events, as assigned.

• Escalate high-risk or complex concerns for leadership review.

• Provider Support & Education

• Offer consultation to providers on clinical risk management topics (e.g., documentation, ethical practice, safety planning, mandated reporting.)

• Participate in provider onboarding, risk-focused learning communities, and other training initiatives.

• Assist in developing clinical risk education materials.

• Connect providers to appropriate support teams and resources when needed.

• Quality Oversight & Improvement

• Partner with Quality Management to investigate complaints and evaluate clinical quality.

• Conduct audits and quality reviews.

• Contribute information and findings that inform provider action plans and quality improvement processes.

• Risk Data & Trends

• Gather, organize, and maintain accurate risk-related data.

• Track and report patterns or anomalies that may indicate emerging trends.

• Summarize and contribute insight to inform leadership review and reporting.

• Technology & Innovation

• Utilize technology systems and tools that support clinical risk management workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Stay current on emerging tools that can strengthen risk monitoring.

• Policy & Systems Development

• Apply Clinical Risk Management SOPs, policies, and workflows consistently in daily work.

• Provide feedback on policies, procedures, and systems based on experience.

• Participate in testing and evaluation of processes or systems.

• Support the communication of updates to providers, colleagues, and other teams/departments as needed.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Share information and coordinate with other clinical teams and other departments, as appropriate.

• Participate in cross-team/departmental projects or initiatives related to safety and risk management.

• Other Duties

• Perform other duties as assigned.

About You

•

• Master’s degree from an accredited University/College in social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy, psychology, or related field.

• Current independent, unrestricted clinical licensure (LCSW, LMHC, LPC, LMFT, Psychologist, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of post-licensure experience as a mental health clinician

• 2+ years of direct clinical experience delivering care as a telehealth practitioner.

• Experience in clinical risk management and crisis intervention.

• Familiarity with clinical quality expectations and ability to consistently apply ethical and clinical best practice standards.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
